quotations.english: St. Neot could not be hid when God would have him revealed

source_text: ge-upped; part. Revealed :-- Ne mihte Scs Neotus behýdd beón ðá ðá God hine geupped habben wolde St. Neot could not be hid when God would have him revealed, Shrn. 12, 15. v. ge-yppan.
